pairs.target: yīwén xiān wèn zhè shìbushì yě yào zhàn zuò , tā jiāng kuàng fàngdào kōng dèng shàng , shuō xiānjiè tā zuò , zìjǐ yào tóng tāmen shuō yíjiàn zhēn yǒu rìzi de shì .

pairs.english: The first day they would measure the old frame, without directly using this soaked little model as a large frame; only on the second day would they fit the new corner piece, first testing an unloaded corner; whether further work could follow would depend on that spot.

pairs.target: tā shuō dào xīn jiǎo jiàn , shǒuzhǐ biàn zài zhuōmiàn bǐ chū cè tiáo tuì kāi de fāngxiàng , tǎ wéi rènchū zìjǐ cóngqián tuī de tài shēn de dìfāng , què méi shēnshǒu qù tì tā bǎizhèng .
pairs.english: As she mentioned the new corner piece, her fingers then traced the withdrawal direction of the side strip on the table; Tavi recognised the place he had once pushed too deep, but did not reach to straighten it for her.

pairs.target: yīwén jiāng jiù tú ná guòqù , zhǐ zhù nà dào xiéxiàn , wèn ruò huàn gèrén kàn , huì buhuì hái yǐwéi tā bǎ zhè yìbiān huàdiào le , mǐlā shuō nǐ xiān shuō zìjǐ kàn bu kàndedǒng .
pairs.english: Iven took the old drawing, pointed to that slanting line and asked whether someone else looking would still think she had crossed out this side; Mira told him first to say whether he understood it himself.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文将旧图拿过去，指住那道斜线，问若换个人看，会不会还以为她把这一边划掉了，米拉说你先说自己看不看得懂。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐ zhuǎnzhèng , zhào jiàntóu shuō xiān tuìchū mù jiǎo , zài nuó cè tiáo , tā tīng wán méi shuō mǎnyì , zhǐ jiào tā zhǐ shì nǎyíkuài , yīwén de zhǐtou zhōngyú tíng dào duì de dìfāng .
pairs.english: He straightened the paper and followed the arrows, saying first withdraw the wooden corner, then move the side strip; she did not say she was satisfied, only asked him to point out which piece; Iven's finger finally stopped at the right place.

pairs.target: " nǐ kěyǐ qù jiāo biérén le . "
pairs.english: “You can go teach other people now.”
pairs.hanzi: “你可以去教别人了。”

pairs.english: Mira laughed after saying it, but Iven handed back the paper and said no; tomorrow afternoon he had to meet an accountant returned from downstream, his own page still unresolved.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说完便笑，伊文却将纸递回，说不去，他明日下午要见从下游回来的账房，自己那页还没问清。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn shì jiùfù jiào de me , tā cóng yī lǐ chōuchū yìzhāng duǎnjiān , shuō jiùfù zhǐ chuán le shíhòu , jiào zìjǐ bié zài tuō biérén shùnlù wèn , zhàngfáng dài bùliǎo jǐrì .

pairs.target: mǐlā shēnshǒu yào ná , tā shuō búshì tāng , zìjǐ kànjiàn shìcóng bù jiǎo chūlái de , tā zhè cái jiāng gānbù yòu zhé kāi , yuánlái lǐ céng hái méiyǒu gāntòu .

pairs.hanzi: 米拉伸手要拿，他说不是汤，自己看见是从布角出来的，她这才将干布又折开，原来里层还没有干透。

pairs.target: tā bǎ mù jiǎo gē dào kōng dié páng , búzài guǒ zhe , wèn tāmen shìbushì xián dài yíkuài shī mùtou chīfàn , yīwén shuō ruò bù shōu zuò qián , zìjǐ hái kěyǐ duō péi tā zuò yíhuìer .

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào zhe ná huí wǎn , mǐlā què méiyǒu jìxù ná kuàng shuō shì , wèn tā zuórì lín kē kàn de zěnyàng , tā shuō tā kànjiàn zìjǐ zuǒshǒu huíbùlái , yě kànjiàn hòulái néng huílái .

pairs.target: yīwén wèn zhè suànbusuàn tā tì tā bǔ le yìtángkè , tǎ wéi shuō tā lián zì dōu méi tì zìjǐ xiě , hái bǎ hùjù wàng zài ménpáng , mǐlā tīng wán , xiào de kuàizi dōu tíng le .

pairs.target: mǐlā diǎntóu , méiyǒu shēnshǒu lái tì tā huà wò bǐng , zhǐ wèn shìbushì hái zuòzài jià biān , tīngjiàn shì , biàn shuō tā nà sāntiān huì bǎ jiàzi de chǐcùn liáng quán , huílái yuànyì gěi tā kàn .

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō yào kàn , tā suíjí bǔ , xiān kàn tā de , búshì náhuíqù quán gǎichéng dùn , tā bèi shuō zhōng xīnsī , dītóu hētāng , yīwén zài pángbiān xiào le yìshēng .
pairs.english: Tavi said he wanted to see it; she immediately added: look at hers first, rather than take it back and turn it all into a shield; his intentions exposed, he lowered his head to drink soup, while Iven laughed once beside him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说要看，她随即补，先看她的，不是拿回去全改成盾，他被说中心思，低头喝汤，伊文在旁边笑了一声。

pairs.target: guò le yízhèn , mǐlā jiāng liǎngzhāng tú bìng zài yìqǐ , jiù de méi rēng , jiào tǎ wéi tì zìjǐ yā yíhuìer jiǎo , shǒu téngchūlái , bǎ zhè zhāng chāizhuāng jìlù zhé dào gān chù .
pairs.english: After a while Mira put together the two drawings, keeping the old one, and asked Tavi to hold a corner for her briefly; with her hands free, she folded the disassembly record into a dry place.
pairs.hanzi: 过了一阵，米拉将两张图并在一起，旧的没扔，叫塔维替自己压一会儿角，手腾出来，把这张拆装记录折到干处。

pairs.target: liǎngzhāng tú zhé zài yìqǐ , jiù tàn hén tòuguò zhǐbèi , mǐlā yòng mǔzhǐ jiāng qiàoqǐlái de biān yāpíng , míngzì réng liúzài zuì wài yìzhé .
pairs.english: The two drawings folded together, old charcoal marks showing through the paper; Mira used her thumb to press flat the curled edge, her name still on the outermost fold.
pairs.hanzi: 两张图折在一起，旧炭痕透过纸背，米拉用拇指将翘起来的边压平，名字仍留在最外一折。

pairs.target: yīwén kànzhe zhǐbiān nàge míngzì , wèn ruò wàng le dàifàn , shìbushì yě yào xiě jìn jìlù , mǐlā shuō yào xiě tā tíxǐng guò le , shěngde huílái hái děi zài tīng yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Iven watched the name at the paper’s edge, asking whether forgetting to bring food should go in the record too; Mira said she would write that he had reminded her, so after returning she need not hear the reminder once more.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文看着纸边那个名字，问若忘了带饭，是不是也要写进记录，米拉说要写他提醒过了，省得回来还得再听一遍。

pairs.target: tiānsè àn xiàqù shí , shítáng zhǐ shèng jǐzhuō rén , mǐlā shōu hǎo mù jiǎo , xiān mō guò bùlǐ , méiyǒu xiàng láishí nàyàng yìbǎ guǒzhù biàn zǒu .
pairs.english: As the light faded, only a few tables of people remained in the dining hall; Mira packed the wooden corner, first feeling inside the cloth, rather than doing as on arrival: wrapping it in one sweep and leaving.
pairs.hanzi: 天色暗下去时，食堂只剩几桌人，米拉收好木角，先摸过布里，没有像来时那样一把裹住便走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tì tā tí kuàng dào ménkǒu , yòu jiāng xìdài jiāohuí tā shǒulǐ , yīwén zǒu zài hòutou , shǒu ànzhe yī lǐ de duǎnjiān , sān rén zài láng kǒu gè tíng le yíxià .
pairs.english: Tavi carried the frame to the door for her, then returned the thin strap to her hand; Iven walked behind, a hand pressing the note inside his clothes; the three each paused once at the corridor entrance.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维替她提框到门口，又将细带交回她手里，伊文走在后头，手按着衣里的短笺，三人在廊口各停了一下。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō jiǔrì hòu cái zǒu , míngrì háiyào chīfàn ne , tǎ wéi biàn xiào zhe ràngkāi yíbù , méi bǎ jīnrì zhè yídùn xiān chī chéng sòngxíng .
pairs.english: Mira said she would leave only nine days later and still needed dinner tomorrow; Tavi smiled and moved one step aside, not turning today’s meal into a farewell in advance.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说九日后才走，明日还要吃饭呢，塔维便笑着让开一步，没把今日这一顿先吃成送行。
